page.layout: One title page: title block centred at the top, an engraving in the middle with the Hebrew name and a banner inside it, then the imprint and date centred below. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: The engraving shows two figures flanking a central figure, with clouds, angels and a radiant Tetragrammaton in Hebrew letters above. The banner in the clouds reads FAC ET SPERA. Small oval cartouche at the foot with an ornament and no text. The left edge of the first and fifth lines is clipped on the scan, so the initial I of "IN IGNATIANAS" and "IN ANNOTATIONES" is uncertain and marked [?]. The printed text reads "VVINDICIAS" in the scan's spelling only where the letter is V; spelling otherwise changed as instructed: SANCTORVM to SANCTORUM, APOSTOLORVM to APOSTOLORUM, LVCAS to LUCAS, IOANNEM to JOANNEM. Library stamps (oval "Biblioteca Nazionale Roma" and a round college stamp on the left) and the Google watermark are not transcribed. The date line is partly covered by the round stamp; the M is legible and the rest is read from the visible letters.
